title: Pitter-Patter Cuttlefish
statement: A teacup-sized cuttlefish with ink-blue freckles putters through a forest of translucent glass arches, flashing little apricot ripples whenever it discovers a new way through. Beneath warm, rain-dappled light, it arranges porcelain pebbles into elaborate spirals—then steals one from the middle to see what happens.
